----------

### is_touchscreen_available

Godot does not have a real check to see if a touch display is available.
This has led to regressions in the past ("Gui/Tree"). 

<details><summary>Details</summary>

https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Agodotengine%2Fgodot%20is_touchscreen_available&type=code

perhaps only `DisplayServerWeb` has it

```js
	godot_js_display_touchscreen_is_available: function () {
		return 'ontouchstart' in window;
	}
```


`DisplayServerAndroid` and `DisplayServerAppleEmbedded` always return `true`(hardcoded)

------

On all other platforms, `is_emulating_touch_from_mouse` is returned.

```cpp
bool DisplayServer::is_touchscreen_available() const {
	return Input::get_singleton() && Input::get_singleton()->is_emulating_touch_from_mouse();
}
```

</details>

Tested on my Android phone in the editor, it mostly works as expected, the only thing that didn't work but might be relevant is the button hover for multiple touches. Some other GUI nodes also don't work well for multiple touches, but I don't think that's really relevant for them (`OptionButton`, `ColorPickerButton`)
These nodes worked well for me: `Button`, `CheckBox`, `TextureButton`. I haven't tested `LinkButton` and `MenuButton`, but these oned probably also doesn't need multitouch support.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f14e9bb2-4087-4181-8985-baffc03d7f4a

Test project: [Test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25814026/Test.zip)
But we still most likely have to wait for review from other teams.

EDIT: As it turns out, hover only works if mouse is emulated from touch, that's why it doesn't work for multiple touches.
I tested it on Android and didn't find any critical regressions. We can still optimize some minor things in the code.

Retested on Android: Touch input and Bluetooth mouse. 

No critical regressions detected, this PR behaves like version 4.6-official _(with input emulation enabled)._

I believe a lot more work is needed before [proposal #3976](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/3976) can be closed / before TouchScreenButton can be marked as deprecated.
The code looks good and I wasn't able to detect any regressions from a quick round of testing, so the PR looks good to go!
